rule.title: Schedule C line 24b takes 50% of the client's business meals

citation.wording: Amount of deduction. In most cases, you can deduct only 50% of your business meal expenses, including meals incurred while away from home on business.

rule.open_point: 50% is applied to every business-meal figure. The same paragraph raises it to 80% for meals during a Department of Transportation hours-of-service duty period, and allows 100% for meals treated as an employee's wages or reported to a nonemployee on Form 1099-NEC; both turn on a person's answer and no question is declared for them yet. Replaces Schedule C line 24b's client_item transform (multiply 0.5), which must be retired with this rule or the figure is halved twice.
